items.title: Dinosaur Era
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Tame 20 DINOSAURS and defend yourselves with 12 NEW WEAPONS while equipping yourselves with 4 NEW ARMOR SETS. Play SURVIVAL or explore a MASSIVE CUSTOM DINOSAUR WORLD. 

+ VELOCIRAPTOR, T-REX, & ANKYLOSAURUS!
+ BRACHIOSAURUS, PTERODACTYL, & SPINOSAURUS!
+ DIPLODOCUS, CARNOTAURUS, & ELASMOSAURUS!
+ TRICERATOPS, BRONTOSAURUS, & MANY MORE!

! Only usable in the world provided

items.title: Tropical Beach Mansions
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Reside in a tropical beach mansion! Live the life of luxury and spend days at the beach!

+ tropical beach homes!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Tetras
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Do you enjoy classic puzzle games? Perhaps even stacking colorful blocks on top of each other? Well you have come to the right place! With these skins you can stack each other with friends and create walls of color art. Or maybe you can create a color maze and blend in perfectly! Or even make a colorful home and be the perfect centerpiece.

- 16 skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: Mob Pals
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Creeper and Enderman make such an iconic team! In this skin pack they are the best of friends and show it by wearing each other's themed attire!

- 9 skins

items.title: Hive Colony Skyblock
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Experience skyblock like never before in this honeycomb themed hive map! Level up your beehive with several resources to unlock. This skyblock world will have you being a busy bee to grow your hive and expand your colony. 

- Lots of skyblock islands with mysterious chests!
- 5 unlockable bee workers that can gather resources for you!
- 18 unlockable areas!

items.title: Demon Teens 2
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Your local demon teens are back in town! They’re up to no good and are ready for you to join them! Be prepared to put on your horns and match with your friends in trendy demon teen style. 

- 12 teen skins with demon horns!
- Perfect for roleplaying!

items.title: Your Royal Highness
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Your royal highnesses, allow me to introduce you to your subjects here to protect, entertain, and make your life easier. It is our pleasure to serve.

+ 12 unique role-playing skins

items.title: Modern Bed Wars
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Modern Bed Wars is a new twist on your favorite multiplayer game!

Compete with your friends to destroy their beds! But remember to protect your bed at all costs!

items.title: Rawr Teens
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
They got the roars and they got the drip! These cute, feline teens can't be missed! 

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Modern attire inspired by anime!

items.title: Attack of Demon Teens
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Do you think demons are scary? Then get ready to see the scariest ones! (Except they are more stylish than others.) Join this teen squad and begin your attack.

+ 10 stylish demon teens
+ By Withercore

items.title: More Mobs
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Make your home in the starting town, complete quests and tasks for the residents, and work your way through the 3 new challenging bosses!

- 20+ New Mobs!
- 3 Unique Bosses!
- Tameable Mobs!
- Rideable Mobs!
- Fast Travel!
- New NPC's and quests!
- Starting Town!

items.title: Anime Hero
items.creator: Syclone Studios
items.description:
Join the battle of good versus evil as either a superhero or villain today with the amazing super characters included in this pack!

+ 12 amazing HD anime skins
+ Choose between super heroes or super villains!
+ Super powers not included.
+ From Syclone Studios

items.title: Cartoon Animals HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Enjoy being an adorable animal drawn in a sweet cartoon style. Strut your stuff like you were just drawn and pulled off the page! Featuring a penguin, fox, panda, duck, and more!

+ 9 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Neon Gamer Demons
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
They are shadows who love to game and glow! In this skin pack called Neon Gamer Demons, you can find many different demons of all colors! 

- 10 skins

items.title: Bizarre Mobs
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Reimagined mobs are definitely interesting to look at! A bit creepy but fascinating nonetheless. Will you choose to be the Creeper or maybe the Enderman? 

- 5 skins
- By: Twin B Studios

items.title: Nether Creatures 3
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
The Nether is crawling with creepy flame monsters! Blend in by using one of these cool fire-themed skins! Explore the Nether as a lava monster!

- 13 skins

items.title: Zoo Visit
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Every time you visit the zoo it almost feels brand new! These zoo animals are just so majestic and beautiful. Which animal is your favorite? Become a purple giraffe today or maybe a blue monkey!

- 10 skins
- By: Twin B Studios

items.title: Among Sus 5
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Roleplay as suspicious and colorful astronauts or maybe skydivers! Fly among the stars or maybe through the clouds!

- 18 skins

items.title: Pixel Mobs HD
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These mobs are super cool, pixelated and in HD! If you like Endermen, Creepers and so many more lovable mobs then this pack is for you! Become a pixel zombie or spider!

- 12 skins
- By: The Lucky Petals

items.title: Millionaire Tropical Mansion
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Have the best summer vacation in this luxurious mansion, with lots of beach and sun!

+ By Street Studios

items.title: Summer Masked Teens
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Prepare your clothes and your masks for the summer, this vacation will be more fun than the others!

- 12 unique skins
- Perfect for summer
- By Pixelusion & TeamPotion

items.title: Soft Pastel Teens
items.creator: Black Arts Studios
items.description:
Fan of soft pastels and cute fashion? this pack is for you! Bring good vibes to your world in soft-hued outfits that make you look the cutest in town!

+ Includes 14 skins
+ By: Black Arts Studios

items.title: Lucky Blocks Skull Island
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
Welcome to Lucky Blocks Skull Island. Break open these mysterious lucky blocks and see what you'll get. Are you going to be lucky or unlucky today?

*Inspired from the original mod
*These blocks can only be played on this world

items.title: Infinity Base
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
Explore an infinitely generating base and claim it as your own. Your friends may brag that they have a large base, but you have an infinite base. Every room you explore opens up into more and more rooms reaching from one end of the world to the other. Show them this base and you will never have the smallest base ever again.
-100+ unique room types
-Random room placement
